message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to three top‑rated picnic spots in Miami—each offering great scenery, plenty of space, and convenient facilities: | Spot | Location & Highlights | Amenities | Best Time | |------|-----------------------|-----------|----------| | **South Pointe Park** | 1 S Ocean Dr., South Beach – overlooks the Atlantic, oceanfront promenade, and historic pier. | • Picnic tables & shaded pavilions
• Restrooms (incl. accessible)
• Dog park (off‑leash hours)
• Free Wi‑Fi hotspots | Early morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds and heat. | | **Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park** | Key Biscayne – iconic lighthouse, sandy beach, nature trails. | • Covered pavilion rentals (reservation required)
• Fire pits (seasonal use only)
• Public restrooms
• Kayak launch point | Mid‑morning on weekdays; weekends may get busy. | | **Lummus Park** | Collins Ave & Washington Ave, South Beach – beachfront stretch with palm trees. | • Built‑in benches & picnic areas
• Restroom stalls
• Skateboard-friendly boardwalk | Sunset time offers cooler temperatures and scenic views. | ### Quick Tips for Your Picnic * **Bring sunscreen, hats, and water bottles** – Miami sun can be intense even during early mornings. * **Check weather forecasts** – sudden showers happen often; bring an umbrella or rain poncho just in case. * **Respect wildlife** – keep food sealed and dispose of trash properly at designated bins. * **Plan parking** – most parks have paid lots; consider arriving before noon to secure free street parking if available. Enjoy your sunny day out! 🌞🍉
